tbesh_html:
1) to release, let drop or loose or rest or fall
1a) (Qal) to let drop or fall
1b) (Niphal) to be made to fall down, be thrown down
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to cause to let drop
1c2) to release, let drop

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to fling down; incipiently to jostle; figuratively, to let alone, desist, remit
strongs_1890.kjv_def: discontinue, overthrow, release, let rest, shake, stumble, throw down.
